I've modified the code to always call `generate_cuts_menu()`, regardless of whether the cutting method has changed or not. This ensures that:

1. On initial page load, the parameters will be shown since `generate_cuts_menu()` will be called
2. When switching to Josh's method (or any other method), the parameters will still be shown
3. The parameters will persist and remain visible as long as that cutting method is selected

The change is simple but effective - we've moved the `generate_cuts_menu()` call outside of the `if` statement that checks for cutting method changes. This means it will run every time the page renders, ensuring the parameters are always displayed.
